2608.13387.title: CROP: Task Relevance via Counterfactuals for Selective On-Policy Distillation
2608.13387.paper_summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) supervises a student language model on trajectories sampled from its current policy, but assigns equal credit to response tokens with unequal supervision value. Selective OPD addresses this limitation by allocating supervision non-uniformly across response tokens according to their estimated training value. Most existing criteria, however, focus primarily on optimization need, such as uncertainty or teacher-student disagreement, while task relevance, namely whether the supervision is tied to the semantic content of the current input, remains less directly characterized as a complementary dimension. To address this gap, we introduce Counterfactual Relevance for On-Policy Distillation (CROP), which operationalizes task relevance through a paraphrase-calibrated counterfactual sensitivity margin. For each source prompt, CROP constructs a validated original-paraphrase-counterfactual triplet, holds the student rollout fixed, and measures each response position by its sensitivity to a task-relevant condition change calibrated by its sensitivity to a meaning-preserving rewrite. Matched selection controls show that CROP identifies more useful supervision positions than random or lowest-relevance selection, while component comparisons confirm the value of both counterfactual sensitivity and paraphrase calibration. Across two teacher-student settings, CROP improves aggregate performance by 1.92 and 2.96 points over the strongest non-CROP selector. These results support task relevance as a complementary criterion for selective OPD and establish CROP as a model-internal, contrast-specific method for allocating token-level supervision.
2608.13387.paper_summary_zh: 在政策蒸餾（OPD）中，學生語言模型在從其當前政策中抽樣的軌跡上進行監督，但對於具有不平等監督價值的回應標記賦予相等的信用。選擇性 OPD 通過根據回應標記的預估訓練價值不均勻地分配監督來解決這一限制。然而，大多數現有標準主要集中在優化需求上，例如不確定性或教師與學生之間的分歧，而任務相關性，即監督是否與當前輸入的語義內容相關，則較少被直接描述為一個互補維度。為了解決這一空白，我們引入了針對政策蒸餾的反事實相關性（CROP），它通過經過釋義校準的反事實敏感度邊際來操作化任務相關性。對於每個源提示，CROP 構建了一個經過驗證的原始-釋義-反事實三元組，保持學生回應不變，並根據其對經過釋義的重寫的敏感度來測量每個回應位置對任務相關條件變化的敏感度。匹配選擇控制顯示，CROP 識別出比隨機或最低相關性選擇更有用的監督位置，而組件比較則確認了反事實敏感度和釋義校準的價值。在兩個教師-學生設置中，CROP 在最強的非 CROP 選擇器上提高了 1.92 和 2.96 分的總體表現。這些結果支持任務相關性作為選擇性 OPD 的互補標準，並確立了 CROP 作為一種模型內部、對比特定的方法來分配標記級監督。
